general.title: Article: Engineering Reliable Telematics from Smartphone Sensors
general.describe: Smartphones make telematics more accessible by combining location, motion sensors, computing power, and connectivity in a single device. But the convenience comes with a trade-off: device placement varies, sampling behavior is managed by the mobile platform, and measurements have different timing and coordinate semantics. This article explores a six-stage architecture to address these challenges. By Praveen Kumar Gopalakrishnan
